name: Event wordmark over a flowing ribbon ground
looks: Thick coloured ribbons curl and loop across a soft gradient field behind a bold two-line event name and year, with a small location line beneath it in a lighter weight.
build: The ribbons are a set of thick SVG paths with rounded caps, drifting slowly along their own length on a loop (background-position or stroke-dashoffset drift), independent of the text. The title and location fade/slide in on a short stagger, power2.out.
sound: A soft ambient swell under the ribbons, a light tick as the title lands.
prompt: Open an event or festival announcement on a lively, looping ribbon-gradient background, with the event's name, year and location fading in over it in a clean type hierarchy, letting the background carry the energy while the type stays calm.
